note: TVA campground on the Watauga River just below Watauga Dam, run under concession by Tennessee Valley Hospitality (Go Camp Tennessee), with a large picnic area, a boat ramp and an overlook of Watauga Lake on the mountain above. No tents of any kind, pop-up campers and rooftop tents included (a bear-safety rule). Some sites are let long-term. --Claude
